data.name: Breakbox
data.detailed_description:
BREAK EVERYTHING. SURVIVE THE FALLOUT. BE THE CAT.

Breakbox is a physics-driven chaos roguelite where destruction isn’t a side effect — it’s the goal.

You play as an unhinged cat (and other unlockable weirdos) dropped into fragile, fully destructible worlds.
Smash buildings. Trigger nukes. Outrun hordes. Stack ridiculous items.

If it exists, it can probably explode.
If it explodes, it probably makes things worse — in the best way possible.

Every run is a gamble.
Every nuke rewrites the map.
Every mistake is loud, funny, and usually fatal.

🧠 WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO

Breakbox is simple to understand and brutally hard to survive:

• Destroy the world to generate Chaos
• Chaos escalates enemies, pressure, and nuclear events
• Loot, level up, and mutate your build mid-run
• Fight bosses that do not respect personal space
• Die gloriously — or escape barely alive

No hand-holding.
No safe floors (okay… some floors are sacred).
Just momentum, knockback, ragdolls, and panic.

💥 KEY FEATURES

Fully Destructible Environments

Buildings blow up. Props shatter. Maps collapse under pressure.
When the nuke drops, nothing is safe.

Physics-Heavy Combat

Explosions launch you. Knockback saves lives.
Ragdolls are tactical. Movement is survival.

The Chaos System

Breaking stuff fuels global chaos.
More chaos = tougher enemies, extra events, nukes, and boss escalation.
You choose how fast things go bad.

Roguelite Builds That Go Off the Rails

Stack abilities, passives, curses, and upgrades.
Builds can become elegant… or deeply cursed. Both are valid.

Playable Cats (and Other Creatures)

Fast. Feral. Absolutely not balanced the way you expect.
Each character shifts how you approach destruction and survival.

Bosses That Mean It

Big. Aggressive. No mercy.
If you win — you earned it.

🐾 THE VIBE

Breakbox is loud, fast, and unapologetically dumb.
It’s part chaos sim, part survival roguelite, part
“why did I do that” machine.

If you like:
• breaking systems
• emergent physics chaos
• high-risk builds
• games that laugh when you fail

You’re home.

Break the world.

Trigger the nuke.

Survive the fallout.

WELCOME TO BREAKBOX.
